segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I just wanted to confirm the revised quote for 42 seats, annual term, and the services package for the June 17 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that matches what we talked about. The only thing I need clear is the invoice timing. Finance wants the first invoice in July, not on signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. I checked with billing, and we can set the contract start date to July 1 with access provisioned June 10 for implementation. First invoice would generate July 2, net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, good. And the amount is still $38,640 for the software and $4,500 for implementation, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. So $43,140 total for year one, before tax if applicable. Years two and three would be software only unless you add services.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We’re not ready for a three-year. Procurement asked if you can do a one-year with the same per-seat price.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I ran that through deal desk this morning. We can hold the $920 per seat on a one-year term if the order is signed by May 24.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That should be fine. Legal had one comment on the auto-renewal. They want 60 days notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s acceptable. I’ll update the order form and send the redline back today. No change to pricing or the July 1 start date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Once we have that, I can route it for signature. Target is still to get the team loaded by June 12.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll also send the implementation checklist after this call so your admin can start gathering user names and cost centers.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send it over and I’ll keep an eye out.
